# Token usage report — widgets

Generated <TS> from session(s) `s1` (1 config dirs, 3 subagents). API-reported usage, deduplicated by message id; local `<synthetic>` placeholders excluded.

**Columns:** *In* uncached input · *Cache w* cache writes · *Cache r* cache reads · *Out* output · *Billable* = In + Cache w + Out (cache reads cost a small fraction of input, so this is the better cost proxy) · *Total* = all four. Times are UTC.
